units.rawText: After observing the Oasis for a while, I get the feeling that everyone is used to life here.

units.rawText: Do you want to know how I know that? You can tell from their room designs. You can see an owner's personality in the aesthetics and practicality of their rooms... And I can see a foundation of "home" in everybody's rooms.

units.rawText: This is quite surprising, Professor. How did you convince everyone to open their hearts? If I had that ability too, I'm sure work would go much more smoothly for me...
